headline: DENUNCIAN A SALAVERRY
content: Supuesta adulteración de fotos en su viaje de Representación. headline: INTERVIEW WITH IDEL VERGER ON EDUCATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE AND CURRICULA CHANGES
content: Idel Verger, former Education Minister, discusses challenges related to educational infrastructure and curriculum changes. According to him, there have been significant delays due to procedural complications which affect maintenance work for schools. Additionally, frequent modifications to school curricula create confusion among teachers who struggle to keep up with these rapid changes. Despite efforts made during his tenure at the Ministry of Education to stabilize some aspects like teacher salaries and improving initial education quality metrics, many issues remain unresolved such as insufficient director appointments necessary for managing funds allocated towards preventive maintenance. Furthermore, while primary education has seen improvements over time based on national evaluations showing increased comprehension levels amongst students compared to previous years, secondary education remains significantly lagging behind according to recent assessments indicating low proficiency rates across various subjects including mathematics and history/geography.

headline: Salud. ADN, clave raíz
content: Hace 20 años conocer el mapa del genoma humano era una utopia. Los técnicos apenas tenían acceso a pedazos del mapa gentico y, a partir de él, trataban de relacionar una secuencia para estudiar alguna patología. Empero, hoy en día la tecnología permite leer el genoma completo de un ser vivo, lo que significa que es posible identificar todos los genes involucrados en ciertos cambios metabólicos que dan lugar a enfermedades. Juan Gabriel de la Cruz, jefe del laboratorio de parentesco de Bio Links, explicó que este progreso científico permite identificar las mutaciones genticas que afectan el ADN y que impiden que el organismo funcione correctamente.

headline: Educación Socioemocional Necesita Mayor Atención Nacional
